reading: Parse `json` with a strict parser, canonicalise, and compare against `canonical` byte for byte and `sha256` hex. `json` is given as text so both languages parse identical bytes. A `refuse` case must raise; a digest for one is a conformance failure, not a near miss.

the window where repr and ECMAScript lay the same digits out differently. 1e-5 and 1e-6 render as plain decimals in ECMAScript and as exponentials in repr

the other end of the same switch: 1e20 is written out in full, 1e21 is not

refuse.why: a lone high surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding. The old json.dumps form raised UnicodeEncodeError here and reached the caller as a 500
the same, on the low half
